meta.name: github-fix-issue
meta.description: Fix GitHub issues end-to-end — from analysis through branch creation, implementation, testing, and PR submission. Use this skill whenever the user mentions fixing a GitHub issue, resolving a bug from an issue tracker, working on a GitHub issue number, or says things like "fix issue

howto.what: 当用户要求修复 GitHub 上的问题时，Claude 会自动分析问题、创建分支、修改代码、运行测试，并提交拉取请求。
howto.when: 当用户提到修复 GitHub 问题、引用问题编号（如 #123）或提供问题链接时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始分析并修复该问题。

say.text: 处理这个 GitHub 问题
say.note: Claude 会查看问题详情并制定修复计划。
Claude 会完成修复并提交拉取请求。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to fix a GitHub issue, Claude automatically analyzes the issue, creates a branch, implements the fix, runs tests, and submits a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions fixing a GitHub issue, references an issue number (e.g., #123), or provides an issue URL.

say_en.note: Claude will start analyzing and fixing the issue.
Claude will view issue details and plan the fix.
Claude will complete the fix and submit a pull request.
